title: H001: Fix README.md project structure accuracy
summary: The project structure tree in README.md was corrected: all 19 internal/ packages now match the filesystem, phantom directories (pkg/, deploy/docker/) and non-existent packages (internal/mesh, internal/observe, internal/logs, internal/audit, internal/access, internal/auth, internal/crypto, internal/hooks, internal/execution) were removed, and the module responsibility table was updated. However, three entries explicitly required by the plan are missing from the tree: deploy/install.sh, deploy/kubernetes/crds/, and the docs/ subtree (reference/, how-to/).

tests_checklist.item: All 19 internal/ packages listed in tree match ls internal/
No stale package references in README prose
docs/ subtree shows reference/ and how-to/ (REQ-008)

code_quality_checklist.item: Package descriptions are concise and accurate
Module responsibility table updated to match new package names

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is as simple as possible

issues_found.description: deploy/install.sh missing from project structure tree. Plan task 1.2 and REQ-003 explicitly require it. The file exists at deploy/install.sh.
issues_found.fix: Add '│   ├── install.sh              # Bare-metal installer script' entry between cloud-init/ and kubernetes/ in the deploy/ subtree.

issues_found.description: deploy/kubernetes/crds/ not shown in tree. REQ-003 scenario 'kubernetes/crds/ listed' requires it to be visible. The directory exists with plexdhook-crd.yaml and plexdnodestate-crd.yaml.
issues_found.fix: Expand the kubernetes/ entry to show crds/ subdirectory, e.g. add '│   │   └── crds/              # PlexdHook and PlexdNodeState CRD definitions' under kubernetes/.

issues_found.description: docs/ entry not expanded to show reference/ and how-to/ subdirectories. REQ-008 explicitly requires 'docs/ shows its subdirectories: reference/ and how-to/'. Currently docs/ is a single unexpanded line.
issues_found.fix:
Expand docs/ to show its subdirectories:
├── docs/
│   ├── how-to/              # How-to guides
│   └── reference/           # Reference documentation

next_steps: Add deploy/install.sh entry to the deploy/ subtree in the project structure tree
Expand deploy/kubernetes/ to show crds/ subdirectory
Expand docs/ to show how-to/ and reference/ subdirectories
